name: Window inner and outer size
plain: Browser window and viewport dimensions, which change constantly.
meaning: Reveals tiling, maximized vs windowed use, sidebars and devtools. Firefox RFP rounds inner size to 200x100 steps (letterboxing) so everyone shares a few buckets.

access.persistence: read fresh on every page load; nothing stored
access.iframe: Readable from cross-origin iframes too (same values)

fields.name: innerWidth, innerHeight
fields.precision: exact; RFP buckets of 200 wide, 100 high

fields.name: outerWidth, outerHeight
fields.range: about inner plus chrome (about 80 to 140 px high)

limits.headline: Can see your browser window and visible page size, as they change
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when the page loads.
can: Check the window's inner and outer size
Notice when you resize or rotate
cannot: See your screen contents or other windows
See which monitor the window is on

story.what_it_is: The size of your browser window and visible page area, which change all the time.

marketing.name: Window.innerWidth
marketing.pitch: Documents how a page reads the width of the visible page area, used for responsive design.

story.for_you: You never see it read. It is why a page reflows when you drag the window narrower, and why a phone gets the mobile layout.
story.for_makers: This is the base of responsive design. Makers also log window sizes to learn real use. Trackers use odd sizes too, since each person resizes their window a bit differently.

use_cases.example: A browser game rescales its play field when you resize the window and keeps the aspect ratio.
A design app like Figma redraws the canvas as you drag the window.
A video call grid reshuffles the tiles when the window shrinks.
A store changes from three columns to one when the window narrows.
An ad network sees a window of exactly 1366 by 768 and sends an ad of the right size.
A fraud check sees a window with no space for browser menus, a sign of an automated headless browser.
A site team learns the real window size, not just the monitor size, to find where designs break.

technical_bounds: Not the same as screen size

history.change: Letterboxing in resistFingerprinting rounds window size
